text: avyaktād aṇḍam abhūd aṇḍād brahmā tataḥ prajāsargaḥ | māyāmayī pravṛttiḥ saṃhriyata iyaṃ punaḥ kramaśaḥ ||
māyāmayo 'py acetā guṇakaraṇagaṇaḥ karoti karmāṇi | tadadhiṣṭātā dehī sacetano 'pi na karoti kiṃcid api ||
yadvad acetanam api san nikaṭasthe bhrāmake bhramati loham | tadvat karaṇasamūhaś ceṣṭati cidadhiṣṭhite dehe ||
yadvat savitary udite karoti karmāṇi jīvaloko 'yam | na ca tāni karoti ravir na kārayati tadvad ātmāpi ||
kartā bhoktā draṣṭāsmi karmaṇām uttamādīnām | iti tat svabhāvavimalo 'bhimanyate sarvago 'py ātmā ||
nānāvidhavarṇānāṃ varṇaṃ dhatte yathāmalaḥ sphaṭikaḥ | tadvad upādher guṇabhāvitasya bhāvaṃ vibhur dhatte ||
gacchati gacchati salile dinakarabimbaṃ sthite sthitiṃ yāti | antaḥkaraṇe gacchati gacchaty ātmāpi tadvad iha ||
rāhur adṛśyo 'pi yathā śaśibimbasthaḥ prakāśate jagati | sarvagato 'pi tathātmā buddhistho dṛśyatām eti ||
sarvagataṃ nirupamam advaitaṃ tac cetasā gamyam | yad buddhigataṃ brahmopalabhyate śiṣya bodhyaṃ tat ||
